assertions.evidence: src/urgency.ts builds a single score question: questions.urgency = { type: "score", criteria: ["1 — Low", ..., "5 — Critical"] }, and test/urgency.test.ts asserts questions.urgency.type === "score" with 5 ordered levels.

The sortable value is computed in code from the model’s score: in rateIncident, urgency = Math.round(answer.score) + 1 and sortScore = answer.score + 1; compareUrgency then sorts by b.sortScore - a.sortScore.
buildRequest sends separate named fields under state: { incident: { service: report.service.trim(), text: report.text.trim() } }; the test deep-equals body.state to { incident: report }.
